release_promise: Constrained multitrack mixing for organized sessions
Reference-assisted workflow with honest A/B comparison
Human-review-backed service when confidence is low

weaknesses.title: Sonic quality is not yet proven
weaknesses.summary: Proof renders do not consistently outperform a human reference.

weaknesses.title: Lead and supporting vocals are not independently controlled
weaknesses.summary: Vocal role routing can collapse into shared paths and produce doubled or buried vocals.

weaknesses.title: Vocal riding is too global
weaknesses.summary: A single RMS target does not hold a rap vocal in the pocket across a full song.

weaknesses.title: Ambience is not a verified send system
weaknesses.summary: Depth still depends too much on inserts and fixed delays.

weaknesses.title: Exposed DSP controls are not fully contract-proven
weaknesses.summary: Named controls can exist before their audible effect is verified.

weaknesses.title: Mastering is still being asked to rescue mix defects
weaknesses.summary: Mastering can be reached before arrangement and vocal pocket are settled.

weaknesses.title: Reference matching is too metric-driven
weaknesses.summary: Similarity scores can coexist with poor human ratings.

weaknesses.title: MixVault learning can absorb weak examples
weaknesses.summary: The learning store needs stricter quarantine and promotion rules.

weaknesses.title: Session ingestion and alignment are still fragile
weaknesses.summary: The system must preserve the intended arrangement exactly.

weaknesses.title: Backend test coverage is still too shallow
weaknesses.summary: The core needs stronger Python and golden-audio coverage.

weaknesses.title: Frontend breadth exceeds verified depth
weaknesses.summary: Too many surfaces can look complete before they are fully wired.

weaknesses.title: Preview and export can diverge
weaknesses.summary: Web audio and offline rendering are separate systems.

weaknesses.title: Production infrastructure is not fully proven
weaknesses.summary: Readiness claims must match the real deployment surface.

weaknesses.title: Security and privacy require production verification
weaknesses.summary: Path validation, tenant isolation, and deletion behavior need hard proof.

weaknesses.title: Legal, rights, and consent rules are not yet enforced enough
weaknesses.summary: Reference ingestion and learning need explicit consent boundaries.

weaknesses.title: Commercial workflow and support are unproven
weaknesses.summary: Billing, revisions, packaging, and fulfillment are not yet proven as a full journey.

in_scope: Stereo mastering from WAV, AIFF, and FLAC
Organized multitrack mixing for constrained roles
Hip-hop and R&B as validated launch genres
Level-matched A/B proof and engineering reports
Human review fallback when confidence is low
out_of_scope: Automatic comping, pitch correction, or timing repair without approval
Full replacement for Logic, Pro Tools, or a human engineer
Training on customer audio without opt-in
Unlimited genres before genre-specific validation exists

phases.name: Truth reset
phases.exit_gate: No readiness claim contradicts the gate dashboard.

phases.name: Deterministic source and session integrity
phases.exit_gate: Benchmark sessions reproduce without missing or shifted audio.

phases.name: Rebuild the vocal engine
phases.exit_gate: Vocal benchmark passes intelligibility and level-consistency tests.

phases.name: Rebuild mix-bus intelligence
phases.exit_gate: No clipping, pumping, or phase instability across the benchmark matrix.

phases.name: Rebuild mastering as a separate approval stage
phases.exit_gate: Masters translate and win blind preference tests.

phases.name: Reference intelligence and confidence
phases.exit_gate: High ESL scores predict human preference on held-out songs.

phases.name: MixVault learning safety
phases.exit_gate: Every recommendation can identify and roll back its supporting examples.

phases.name: One real frontend workflow
phases.exit_gate: New beta users complete the workflow without developer help.

phases.name: Backend production hardening
phases.exit_gate: Load and disaster-recovery tests pass without lost jobs.

phases.name: Security, privacy, legal, and billing
phases.exit_gate: Security review passes and policies match behavior.

phases.name: Closed beta and market validation
phases.exit_gate: At least 30 completed songs and 80% successful delivery.

phases.name: Controlled commercial launch
phases.exit_gate: Four consecutive weeks meet quality, reliability, and support targets.

definition_of_market_ready: Preserve intended performance and arrangement decisions
Make the majority of validated songs sound clearly better
Keep vocal results stable, intelligible, dimensional, and artifact-free
Correlate automated confidence with human preference
Prevent bad results from entering production learning
Support safe upload, payment, processing, revision, approval, download, and deletion
Survive retries, worker failures, and browser closure
